title: Let-Mi: An Arabic Levantine Twitter Dataset for Misogynistic Language
findings: The paper introduced a novel category of misogyny called 'damning', which captures religiously-phrased abuse common in Arabic culture (e.g., 'May God curse you'). The experimental analysis, particularly the confusion matrix, showed that this category is challenging for models to detect, often being misclassified as non-misogynistic content.
